paragraphs.text: Makare was an Amonkheti human who fell during the Final Hours , and became an Eternal .
Makare had brown hair and wore a bronze-striped dress.

Makare had pledged her forbidden love to Genub , defying the God-Pharaoh . They stuck together during the Hour of Eternity but were separated in an attack by a Spellweaver Eternal . She fell to its spells and was risen as an Eternal . When Genub found her again, surrounded by Eternals, he rushed to join her, but she turned, raising a bloody axe, and showed him her glowing blue eyes. As Genub reached her, she struck him down. They would be rejoined in death.
She became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and was re-killed by Vitu-Ghazi .
